title: Amber Smog — Villeneuve Monolith Hero
description: A title slide engineered like cinematic key art — a towering heavy serif drowns the frame in smog-orange haze while a whisper-small CJK corner glyph and lone blinking-dot status marker signal a world mid-collapse. Oppressive atmosphere over neon spectacle.
philosophy: This template exists to weaponise stillness. Where most cyberpunk decks reach for purple grid-lines and chromatic-aberration overload, this design insists on the silence of a poisoned sky — Villeneuve over Tron. Scale and atmosphere do the work that colour quantity would ruin. It is built for speakers who understand that the heaviest ideas arrive without flourish, and for rooms that need to feel the weight of a premise before a single data point is shown.
goodFor: Cinematic product or game reveals where mood must precede the pitch
Opening keynote slides demanding instant, wordless tonal authority
Film, documentary, or speculative-fiction brief decks
Creative-agency concept presentations with a dystopian or noir angle
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring legible data density
Cheerful consumer-brand campaigns or lifestyle product launches
Academic papers and citation-dense research presentations
Multi-column or FAQ-layout slides where body text must be readable at small scale
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Cinematic still from a poisoned city at dusk — amber smog erases the horizon and makes the sky feel like a ceiling pressing downward onto the frame. The composition is monolithic and vertical, with typography that functions as architecture rather than language: massive, still, load-bearing. Mood channels the Villeneuve school of speculative cinema — silence, atmospheric weight, and slow dread without spectacle. Avoid neon glow trails, chromatic aberration, or any frantic visual energy; the oppressive stillness of the haze is the only tool.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed composition with a breathing outer margin on all sides; the monolithic title block occupies the lower two-thirds of the vertical frame, anchored below the optical center like load-bearing architecture rather than a conventional headline. A CJK glyph sits at whisper scale in the lower-right corner, acting as a visual counterweight to the dominant type mass. A lone status-dot marker is pinned to the bottom-left ground plane. No header band, no rule lines — hierarchy is carried entirely by scale contrast between the hero type and everything else.

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a frame held too long — a cinematic pause where one heavy idea breathes inside smog-thick silence. Compositional rhythm is sparse and asymmetric: a single dominant typographic mass in the left-center zone, surrounded by deliberate void that reads as atmospheric pressure rather than emptiness. Mood is mid-collapse stillness — not ominous action, but the hush before it. Avoid decorative neon flourishes, symmetrical layouts, and any visual density that would fracture the monolithic gravity.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; primary content block (a single pull-quote, lone stat, or two-line declaration) anchors to cols 2–7, leaving the right third as uninterrupted atmospheric bleed. A hairline rule separates the dominant typographic mass from a whisper-small attribution or sub-label below it, with no decorative header band. A CJK glyph or blinking-dot status marker sits bottom-left at the outer margin; page number appears bottom-right in isolated negative space. Hierarchy is enforced through scale contrast alone — no background panels or bounding boxes.
